description: This file defines the InMemoryTransportConnection class, which implements in-memory transport connection functionality for testing Orleans nodes. It manages connection lifecycle, piping, and event handling within the in-memory transport setup.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportConnection
classes.description: Implements an in-memory transport connection for Orleans testing, managing connection lifecycle, piping, and disconnection events.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new in-memory transport connection with specified memory pool, logger, and endpoints.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new in-memory transport connection that is a reversed pair of an existing connection, with a new local endpoint.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Prepares the connection for closing, cancels pending reads and writes, and triggers the closure process.

methods.name: OnClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup and state update when the connection is closed.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the connection resources, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the connection, including local and remote endpoints.
